notes.title: A little update
notes.notes:
Hey all,

It recently came to my attention that the copyright status of a song featured in A Date in the Park had changed - so unfortunately I've had to remove the song from the game for the time being.

On the flip side, this also gave me the opportunity to rebuild the game in an updated version of the engine - meaning it should now run a little smoother on Steam and you can switch between full screen and windowed mode by pressing Alt+Enter.

Please note: the update may mean old save game files will not work anymore. If you were part way through the game you may need to start over - apologies!! This is due to engine limitations that mean save games can be broken when the game is updated.

Thanks for your support!
Shaun
Cloak and Dagger Games

notes.title: An update on our next game on Greenlight
notes.notes:
Hi guys,

Thanks for all you support with out latest game on Greenlight - the point and click mystery/thriller Football Game - we had a nice little surge in votes recently which has put us up above 300 yes votes in total. 

We've got a healthy Yes/No ratio so hopefully the game might be Greenlit soon - in the meantime, if you haven't checked out the game, your vote is much appreciated, we need all the help we can get! If you were a fan of A Date in the Park I think you will like this one too, it has a similar vibe. 

You can check the Greenlight page out here: 

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=899201612

The game features an original soundtrack from one of my favourite bands, JUPITER-C - check out their latest video here to hear the kind of musical flavour the game will have:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JedkB5-VV6M

Many thanks for your support!

Shaun
Cloak and Dagger Games

notes.title: Sumatra Greenlight update... and Ron Gilbert!
notes.notes:
Hi guys,

Thanks again for your support of our upcoming game, Sumatra. The Greenlight campaign has been going very well, we are now at 299 yes votes, just one shy of 300! We have a very healthy yes/no ratio which is giving us a lot of confidence moving forward. Any help you can give us to push past 300 and beyond is always immensely appreciated!

http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=864100054

A few days ago we had a great boost in votes thanks to the legend that is Ron Gilbert, creator of Monkey Island and Maniac Mansion, who retweeted us on Twitter. Being a fan of Mr Gilbert since I was a child, this was possibly the coolest thing that has happened since we started making games, and I may indeed print this screenshot off and frame it.

http://i67.tinypic.com/219dt07.png

Thanks for your support,

Shaun
Cloak and Dagger Games
